## Result and scope

Complete affirmative candidate for rank 455 / ID 20001515 (AIM 5.2), obtained in one substantive attempt: for phi(a)=a, phi(b)=ab and phi(c)=bcb, the mapping torus has a proper cocompact action on a three-dimensional CAT(0) cube complex.

The explicit compact quotient has 1 vertex, 7 edges, 8 squares and 2 three-cubes. Its vertex link has 14 vertices, 32 edges and 16 triangles and is flag. Reversible presentation changes identify its fundamental group with the exact target.

## Review and reproducibility

- Full fresh independent adversarial audit: PASS, no mathematical repair.
- Original mathematical proof remains frozen at SHA-256 c022afdfe003d0692a032cee48855ddf712de22953b358b895c485215875d8a6.
- Full audit, actual cube attaching maps, independent geometric/algebraic programs and results are included.
- All three standard-library verification programs pass.
- This is an internally reviewed mathematical candidate, not external peer review or a historical-priority certificate. No virtual-specialness or minimum-dimension claim is made.

## Source identity

The exact ab,bcb formulation is verified in both archived AIM captures:
- https://web.archive.org/web/20240828224508id_/http://aimpl.org/freebycyclic/5/
- https://web.archive.org/web/20260310215532id_/http://www.aimpl.org/freebycyclic/5/

Current live AIM/UnsolvedMath access remains unverified. The workshop summary's different b -> aba formula and its nearby three-dimensional candidate remain explicitly distinguished. No first-resolution claim is made.

## Change boundary

Thirteen text/code/result files under unsolved_math_prioritization/attempts/20001515/ plus only this QUEUE.md row's Status and Turns fields: claimed_solved, 1/5. Every other queue byte and all unrelated main-branch work are preserved. No source HTML/PDF, raw corpus, screenshots or private context is included. Main has not been moved; no PR merge or release has been performed.

Main snapshot integrated without moving main: 329e7303d4616ebcf060a3c8731bd62ed1fa339a.
